objective: Test statistical edge in R units before any account-capital or leverage decision.
hypothesis: In a rising long-term trend, volatility compression followed by a confirmed close above a prior range can precede a persistent expansion move.

common_rules.breakout: close[t] > maximum high of the preceding breakout_days, excluding t
common_rules.initial_stop: entry - 2 * ATR20 known at signal close
common_rules.exit: initial stop or close after maximum_holding_sessions
common_rules.gap_stop: fill at session open when open is below stop
common_rules.sizing: one unit of initial risk; results reported in R
common_rules.overlap: one position per asset and variant
common_rules.period_boundaries: each train, validation and OOS segment starts flat

statistical_gates.family_density_gate: At least 2 of 8 neighboring variants must pass on at least 2 assets; an isolated winner is not density.

robustness_sequence_if_pass: only then capital, costs, fractional shares and leverage
prohibitions: No capital-dollar gate in edge discovery.
No parameter optimization after seeing this screen.
No SQCLI search unless the preregistered density gate passes.
No paper or live authorization from this screen.
